description: This file contains unit tests for the RingRange class, focusing on operations such as difference, complement, intersection, and containment logic within the Orleans distributed system framework.

classes.name: RingRangeTests
classes.description: A sealed class containing unit tests for the RingRange data structure, verifying its behavior in various set operations and edge cases.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_EquallyDividedRange
methods.description: Tests the difference operation on equally divided ring ranges.

methods.name: ComplementDoesNotIntersect
methods.description: Verifies that the complement of a ring range does not intersect with the original range.

methods.name: ComplementComplementIsEqual
methods.description: Checks that the double complement of a ring range returns the original range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_HolePunch
methods.description: Tests the difference operation creating a hole in the ring range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty
methods.description: Verifies that subtracting an empty range from another range returns the original range.

methods.name: RingRangeDifference_Empty_Two
methods.description: Checks the difference between two specific ranges, including edge cases.

methods.name: RingRangeIntersection
methods.description: Tests the intersection and difference of full and empty ranges.

methods.name: RingRangeContains
methods.description: Verifies containment logic for various ranges, including wrapped ranges.

methods.name: EqualRangeInvariants
methods.description: Ensures that equally divided ranges cover the entire uint.MaxValue space without overlaps.
